⚠️Traffic Advisory⚠️ 

9th St at Francisco.  

Officers are aware of the continued aggressive behavior and intimidation of motorists by window washers who continue to block traffic and vandalize vehicles. Several reports have been completed and several individuals have been cited.  

Officers will continue their efforts for the safety of the motorists and window washers.

data.raw_text:
🚨LANDFALL: Cat 1 Typhoon Bualoi (OpongPH) has made her final landfall at the border of Hà Tĩnh and Nghe An Provinces, Vietnam after storming through the Philippines and sailing across the span of the South China Sea. Though she fortunately failed to intensify as much as initially forecast, Bualoi is still brimming with a deluge of heavy, tropical rainfall. By far the largest threat for the communities of North-Central Vietnam from this storm is inland flooding. 

Bualoi is the 8TH cyclone to make landfall in the West Pacific Basin at Typhoon-strength this year.
